title: Low-regularity invariant measure for the complex-valued mKdV
summary: In this paper we consider the twice-renormalized, complex-valued modified KdV (mKdV) on the one-dimensional torus introduced by Chapouto. Our main result is the construction of an invariant measure supported at low-regularity. This work complements the work of Kenig et al., which constructed invariant measures supported in higher-regularity spaces for the non-renormalized mKdV. Due to the low-regularity of the support of the measure, we are forced to work in Fourier-Lebesgue spaces.
